censusNote: INDEC final Census 2022, tables 1.1–1.24. Counts show census residents, not registered voters or turnout by demographic group. Sex recorded at birth; INDEC redistributed X/none of the above into female and male in these tables. Median age is for residents in private dwellings. Local data use census jurisdictions matched by name to electoral sections, not to circuits. Province-level age shares (%) use the chart on p. 21; ages 15–64 are the remainder from the two published rounded shares.

rivers.label: Natural Earth · rivers and lake centerlines

notes: INDEC final Census 2022, tables 1.1–1.24. Counts show census residents, not registered voters or turnout by demographic group. Sex recorded at birth; INDEC redistributed X/none of the above into female and male in these tables. Median age is for residents in private dwellings. Local data use census jurisdictions matched by name to electoral sections, not to circuits. Province-level age shares (%) use the chart on p. 21; ages 15–64 are the remainder from the two published rounded shares.
CEPAL’s comparable provincial estimate; this is not nominal GDP or a province’s own PBG calculation.
The source flags 2023 as provisional in the industry sheets and preliminary in the national summary.
Industry shares are at constant 2004 prices. They are not employment, export shares, or subsidy amounts.
National share uses the official national total, which includes a small geographically unallocated amount.
Province data cannot be interpreted as estimates for individual electoral circuits.
Jurisdiction-level aggregates only; nothing is assigned to election sections, voting circuits, individual households or voters.
Nominal 2023 amounts are comparable across jurisdictions as annual reported flows, not to constant-price economic output (VAB).
FCT is a specific electricity tariff-compensation program, not total energy aid, all electricity subsidies or total government subsidies. No FCT allocation is reported for CABA in this series.
Potenciar Trabajo beneficiary counts reconcile with the source total. The report’s monetary breakdown was excluded because its province values do not reconcile to the printed total.

FCT is already included in RON; do not add the two. RON excludes national-government, national social-security, and unallocated national treasury funds; it does not represent a comprehensive accounting of all federal transfers.
Per-resident figures use 2022 census population. “GVA per resident” is output divided by population, not personal income. Nominal financing cannot be directly compared with constant-2004-peso GVA.

Density uses INDEC 2022 counts and IGN area. Tierra del Fuego area and density are omitted because the reported IGN provincial area includes Antarctic and South Atlantic claims outside the map footprint.

Rivers are simplified Natural Earth 1:50m vectors clipped to the atlas footprint. Terrain names are approximate label locations, not boundaries or elevation contours. City locations are selected reference points.
